_doc: List prices of the Claude API for the ledger (explainer_engine/llm/claude_api.py). USD per million tokens. Re-check them on the pricing page before a big batch; a model missing here is refused, never guessed. Not a money ceiling: the ceilings live only in config/spend_caps.json (claude_api). Models with role 'server-side fallback target' answer when fallbacks: default re-runs a refused request; they are never requested directly.
